data.body: [P1] This final fatal check still runs before the surrounding `ExecutionManager` resource is closed. After a handoff timeout, checkpoint draining or operation shutdown can block there while the handler scope later reports a `ThreadDeath` or `VirtualMachineError`; the method then returns the original PENDING/RETRYING outcome without observing that fatal. Hoist the fatal state outside the try-with-resources and perform the last check after resource closure, with a regression test that releases fatal scope cleanup while shutdown is blocked.
